parameters.name: BindMiniProgram
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable mini program binding. Valid values:
- **Y**: Enabled.
- **N (default)**: Disabled.

parameters.name: CheckFileBody
parameters.description: The content of the uploaded verification file.

parameters.name: CheckFileName
parameters.description: The name of the uploaded verification file.

parameters.name: DegradeAppScheme
parameters.description: The iOS app scheme for degradation redirect.

parameters.name: DeviceRiskPlus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable enhanced device risk detection. Valid values:
- **Y**: Enabled.
- **N**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The mini program platform to bind. Valid values:
- **WECHAT**: WeChat.
- **ALIPAY**: Alipay.
- **TIKTOK**: TikTok.

parameters.name: ReturnPicCount
parameters.description: The number of face photos for evidence storage (1-5).

parameters.name: ReturnVideoLength
parameters.description: The duration of the evidence storage video, in seconds.

parameters.name: StoreImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to deliver files generated during verification to the customer's OSS. Valid values:
- **Y**: Yes.
- **N**: No.
